schemas.name: Powered by the Apocalypse
schemas.author: Project Logos Community
schemas.description: Standard 2d6 + Stat action evaluation schema with Strong Hit (10+), Weak Hit (7-9), and Miss (6-) outcome branches.

schemas.name: Forged in the Dark
schemas.author: Project Logos Community
schemas.description: Dice pool action evaluation schema. Evaluates Nd6 pool, highest die check (66 Crit, 6 Full, 4-5 Partial, 1-3 Bad), and 0-Rating 2d6 keep-lowest exception rules.

schemas.name: Pathfinder 2e Action Adjudication
schemas.author: Project Logos Community
schemas.description: Four-tier Degree of Success AST schema (Crit Success DC+10, Success >=DC, Crit Failure DC-10, Failure <DC) with Natural 20 / Natural 1 degree-shifting rules.
schemas.function_contract: pf2e_eval(roll_total: int, natural_roll: int, dc: int)

schemas.name: Generic d20 System Reference
schemas.author: Project Logos Community
schemas.description: Baseline d20 + Modifiers vs DC evaluation schema featuring Advantage / Disadvantage resolution and Critical Hit/Miss threshold rules.
schemas.function_contract: d20_eval(roll_total: int, dc: int, advantage_state: str = 'NORMAL')
